ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and close the case; no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
The rider cancelled 1 min 40 s (100 s) after acceptance, well inside the 3-minute window [F2][NS-4]. Under NS-4, a rider cancellation within 3 minutes of matching is not chargeable, so the $6.61 fee fails the free-cancellation ceiling and falls to be refunded in full [F5][NS-4]. The trace confirms the cancellations-within-3-minutes benchmark: 100 s after acceptance, and NS-4 is the only branch reached via NS-0 for a rider-cancelled on-demand booking [F2][NS-0].

The driver-side route (NS-1) was never engaged: the driver never tapped "I'm Here" and no automatic arrival was recorded [F4], no arrival was registered on the timeline [F3], and the driver's closest approach to the pickup point was 2,138 m at the moment of cancellation — never within 200 m [F1]. NS-1 consequently cannot be satisfied and the fee cannot be sustained on a no-show basis [F1][F3][F4][NS-1]. The driver's written assertion that he was on his way [F8] is a statement, not a system record, and in any event does not meet NS-1's arrival-and-waiting conditions [F8][NS-1].

No admissible supplement applies: the fare record shows no surge and the toll/ERP field is not engaged [F6][RD-2]. The traffic band on EU TONG SEN STREET [F9] and the absence of incidents [F10] are irrelevant to a cancellation-fee dispute and do not create a charge [F9][F10][NS-4].

Amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee recorded at $6.61 [F2][F5]; refund is the full $6.61, issued as a voucher under NS-7 [F5][NS-7]. No flag_account is warranted: the fee fails only because the cancellation was within the free window, not because the driver abused the arrival or waiting button — the driver never pressed it [F4][NS-2]. The driver profile (0 upheld disputes in 90 days) does not itself decide the case or support a flag [F13][RD-6]; the rider's own prior no-show disputes are likewise profile-only and cannot decide this case [F12][NS-1].
